meta.title: Customer support after installation
meta.description: Had an appliance installed by Bluebolt? Call our hotline for help, see how to register your installation warranty and read our payment safety tips.

title: Support after installation
lead: Bluebolt installs appliances on behalf of the brand or store you bought from. If you need a check-up, want to register your warranty or have a question about your appointment, call our hotline.

hotlineCard.title: Customer care hotline
hotlineCard.hoursPending: Support hours are being updated on the website.

register.title: Register your installation warranty
register.lead: The service warranty covers the installation work done by Bluebolt technicians.

prepare.title: Have your details ready
prepare.body: Your name, phone number, installation address, sign-off date and appliance. Add the order code or purchase receipt if you have it.

contact.title: Call the hotline
contact.body: Call {phone} and say you want to register your installation warranty.

confirm.title: Get confirmation
confirm.body: Customer care records your request and books a check-up if one is needed.

register.formPending: A warranty form on the website (P1) will go live once its own contract is approved.

terms.title: Warranty periods
terms.fallback: Warranty periods depend on the type of service and are being updated on the website. Call our hotline to confirm the period for your job.
terms.conflictNote: Conflict to resolve: the old policy gives new installations a 2-month warranty, while an old article says 12 months. The table appears in the live version only once content/sla.ts holds an approved value.

payment.title: A note on payments
payment.tip: Before sending money to anyone who claims to act for Bluebolt, call {phone} to check.
payment.materialsLink: See the reference price list for materials

final.title: Didn't find what you need?
final.body: Call our hotline or see other ways to reach Bluebolt.
